RegistrationInfo.Description: Runs Trader AI's Phase 7 weekly tournament evaluation once per week (D-03: weekly cadence; D-10: same Task Scheduler pattern as the Phase 5 tasks). StartBoundary is Sunday 15:00 NZ local time -- the full US trading week (ending Friday ~08:00-10:00 NZ Saturday, DST depending) is closed and reconciled well before this fires, and it cannot collide with the daily guardian/entry/reconcile tasks' weekday windows. The tournament reads the paper ledger and writes only its own tournament_* tables and the strategy_registry, so a same-day overlap with any read-only report task is harmless. Registration deferred to the existing 05-09 go-live checkpoint batch (one more schtasks line -- no separate human session).
